subject: english
question: What unintended outcome arose from the CoWIN platform?

options.text: It reduced transparency of vaccine data
It left digitally inexperienced users excluded

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The CoWIN platform was introduced to streamline registration and tracking during India’s vaccination drive.
 
• However, the passage clearly states that millions of people were unintentionally excluded.
 
• Those without smartphones or lacking basic digital literacy found it difficult to register on the platform.
 
• Thus, the unintended outcome was that it **left digitally inexperienced users excluded**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Supporting Line from Passage:** *“However, this technological solution unintentionally excluded millions who did not own smartphones or lacked basic digital literacy…”*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** The passage does not say digital systems slowed down.
 
• **Option 2:** No mention of reduced transparency.
 
• **Option 4:** No reference to security issues.
